name: @vistta/codehub
description: Your IDE, anywhere. A self-hosted development environment powered by code-server. Run it on your computer or in Docker; access it through a browser, the desktop app, or the Android client.

scripts.build:windows: npm run stage && vistta build ./app windows --setup=./app/setup.js --build=build/app --out=dist --name=vistta-code-hub --target=nsis
scripts.build:linux: npm run stage && vistta build ./app linux --setup=./app/setup.js --build=build/app --out=dist --name=vistta-code-hub --target=deb,appimage

author: Tiago Terrenas Almeida
